title: Savannah’s Coastal Empire
summary: A besieged Garou protectorate in Georgia.

claims.text: The Shadow Lord Karl Ironhand and Karl’s pack seized Savannah’s Coastal Empire from a degenerate Fianna bloodline and held it for some twenty years against vampires, sorcerers and worse, ruling for about twenty-five.
The city has been under siege for decades, and there are never enough Garou to keep the protectorate safe as aid from the other Southeastern tribes dwindles.

title: The Southern Protectorate
summary: The Garou of the American Southeast, as one novel tells it.

claims.text: The novel The Poison Tree tells that the Southern Protectorate takes in the Garou from Mississippi to South Carolina and south into Florida, and that its Solstice Moot meets under the Grand Elder Helen Oakheart.
